bottomLine: Signal Lispro is a standard-issue AI trading desk with the usual strengths and the usual omissions. None of the omissions are dealbreakers - they are conditions.
We rate it 4.5 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$200 minimum is the right size for testing either.
